policy: Execute every automatable external-readiness check now; preserve physical, human, signing and real-learner evidence as explicit HOLDs until actually performed.

livePages.existingEvidence: Pages run 34806712586 verified the live release-hold boundary twice, including the stable non-production preview, version/cache consistency, immutable preview cache, local-only device helper and private-path 404 boundary.
livePages.bookVerifierEvidence: The post-Pages verifier matched trusted main to the deployed Pages source and verified live /preview/ release 2026.09.14.4, 8 parts / 46 chapters, the 116 supported / 21 scoped-qualified / 0 hold / 0 conflict authorization snapshot, non-self-promoting authored drafts, and shared Read/Listen runtime markers.
livePages.boundary: Automated live-byte verification does not substitute for physical-device, assistive-technology, SME or learner evidence.

physicalPwa.required: Current-runtime physical iOS/iPadOS and Android install, standalone, offline restart/reboot, update recovery and storage-pressure evidence.

windowsDistribution.required: Partner Center identity, signed/Store provenance, real Windows launch, SmartScreen or Store reputation path and WACK/equivalent validation.

bookSme.required: Independent human review of all 46 Book chapters with priority review of safety, V/P transfer, gate seal, troubleshooting, cavity pressure, monitoring and complex diagnostics.

curriculumSme.required: Human SME semantic approval of all 120 canonical lessons remains separate from Book review.

learnerPilot.required: Real learners and longitudinal evidence; synthetic/proxy datasets cannot satisfy this boundary.

productImprovement.rule: Only convert observed physical, SME or learner findings into product changes with a traceable evidence reference; do not pre-claim improvements or efficacy before observations exist.
